name: Harem in Another World
source: In Harem in Another World, you play as your normal everyday pervert, who is suddenly transported to another world. Explore this open and mysterious place through different lands to try and find your lost friends. Meet all manner of people and characters, from ghosts, to goblins, to giants and more!
translation: 在《异世界后宫》中，你扮演的是平常的变态，突然被传送到了异世界。穿过不同的土地探索这个开放而神秘的地方，尝试找到你失踪的朋友。认识各种各样的人和角色，从鬼魂、妖精、巨人等等！
